chunks: The unbelievers claim that they will not be raised again. Tell them: "Why not? By my Lord, you will certainly be raised again, and then informed of what you had done. That is how the law of God works inevitably."
ai.seo_question: What is the certainty of resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah At-Takathur, this verse directly counters the materialist assertion of the disbelievers that death is the final end, affirming the certainty of bodily resurrection (Ba'th). It highlights the divine attribute of ease in reckoning, a concept often linked in Shia exegesis to the precision of the Tablet and Pen, ensuring that no deed, however small, escapes divine notice. This serves as a foundational proof for the Day of Judgment and the subsequent accounting of human actions.
